about: 'Are We Family', the weekly grouping game (are-we-family.html). Edited by hand, like lyrics.json: one puzzle a week, four groups of four songs, easiest group first. Titles must match the official song list (data/song-index.json) exactly. hl gives the word hidden in a title, letters only (it may run across a space) (shown once the group is solved); note is an optional line under the group. Once the game opens, only add puzzles to the end: never change, reorder or remove one that is scheduled (node scripts/check-game-schedule.js). Drafts and the reasoning for each group: docs/The Hip Handbook - Are We Family - Puzzle Drafts.md.
